The '''Sernpidal Enforcers''' were security personnel who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]], when the world was under the jurisdiction of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]]. They carried out patrols in [[Sernpidal City]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], in an attempt to maintain peace.<ref name="TBoDR" />

{{RPG|''[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]''}}
In [[3957 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' gives a date of [[3956 BBY]] as the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] searches for the [[Star Forge]] as a [[Jedi training/Legends|retrained]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], a mission that is depicted in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. When Revan visits the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in ''Knights of the Old Republic'', [[Deesra Luur Jada]] tells [[Gender/Legends|him]] that [[Bastila Shan]] and her [[Jedi strike team (Capture of Darth Revan)|strike team]] had [[Capture of Darth Revan|assaulted]] [[Darth Revan's flagship|Darth Revan's ship]] nearly a year ago (Dialog StrRef 6568). Therefore, ''[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]'' can be dated to [[3957 BBY]].</ref> a team of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents traveled to Sernpidal on a [[Mission to Sernpidal|mission]] to obtain a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Doel Scherp]]. The agents tried to learn Scherp's location on the world by intimidating citizens in Sernpidal [[City/Legends|City]], so a group of Sernpidal Enforcers attempted to apprehend the agents and take them into custody.<ref name="TBoDR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sernpidal Enforcers were created by [[Patrick Stutzman]] and appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement ''[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]'' for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition'']]. In the supplement, the players role-play as a group of Republic agents and they can pursue a number of different methods for learning the location of Commander Scherp. If they chose to use intimidation, then after they have made three intimidation attempts, the agents are attacked by six Sernpidal Enforcers. The Enforcers can also call for reinforcements if necessary. To portray the Enforcers, the supplement advises the players to use the [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] statistics provided on page 69 of the sourcebook ''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="TBoDR" />
